title: Rust: Token Bucket Rate Limiter
description: Implement a token bucket rate limiter in Rust.

steps.title: Periodic Refill
steps.description: Implement a `TokenBucket` struct with `capacity` and `tokens`. Add a `try_consume(&mut self) -> bool` method. Create a bucket with capacity 5, consume 3 tokens successfully, then try to consume more.
hints: `try_consume` checks if tokens > 0, decrements if so.
Consume 3 from 5 → 2 left, then consume 3 more fails on the 3rd.

verification.failureMessage: Print true when tokens available, false when exhausted.

steps.title: Periodic Refill
steps.description: Add a `refill(&mut self, count: usize)` method. Create a bucket with capacity 3, consume 3, refill 2, consume 2 more. Print each result.
hints: Refill adds tokens up to capacity.
`fn refill(&mut self, count: usize) { self.tokens = (self.tokens + count).min(self.capacity); }`
Consume 3 → empty, refill 2 → consume 2 success, consume 1 fails.

verification.failureMessage: Consume until empty, refill, consume again.

steps.title: Time-Based Refill
steps.description: Add time-based refill: track `last_refill_time`. Every `refill_interval_ms`, add `refill_amount` tokens. Simulate by advancing time manually.
hints: Before consuming, call a `check_refill()` that checks if enough time has passed.

verification.failureMessage: Print true after waiting for refill.

steps.title: Thread-Safe Rate Limiter
steps.description: Wrap TokenBucket in `Arc<Mutex<>>` and test with 5 concurrent threads attempting to consume 1 token each from a bucket with 3 capacity. Count successful vs blocked attempts.
hints: Each thread calls `try_consume` inside a lock.
Count successes and print: '3 succeeded, 2 blocked'.

verification.failureMessage: 5 threads try to consume from 3-token bucket.

steps.title: Multi-Key Rate Limiter
steps.description: Extend the rate limiter to support multiple keys (e.g., per-user). Use a `HashMap<String, TokenBucket>`. Test with two users each having their own rate limits.
hints: `struct RateLimiter { buckets: HashMap<String, TokenBucket>, capacity: usize, ... }`
`fn check(&mut self, key: &str) -> bool` gets or creates bucket for key.
User A and User B operate independently.

verification.failureMessage: Test rate limiting with two independent users.
